{{armor art infobox | campaign = [[Eye of the North]] | pvp = Norn Woad | pvpreward = Basic | specialgallery = Norn Woad }} [[Norn Woad]] is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the [[Norn title track]] to be able to craft this armor.
